skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic economic and social knowledge and apply it to real-world problems in the real estate industry.
Gain knowledge about practical activities in the real estate business, including management, brokerage, valuation, and property management.
Understand government management activities related to real estate.
Develop skills to gather, analyze, and organize information from practical activities.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and take responsibility for personal and group tasks.
Improve critical thinking skills necessary for working in practical environments.
Develop self-learning skills to improve work habits and express personal views.
Ability to present issues and defend personal viewpoints.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the workplace.
Ability to plan and use appropriate resources for research topics.
Ability to write reports with clear structure, accurate content, and effective presentation.
